why: The blocks and defaults of the dungeon room kit's PUZZLE and VAULT kinds (tools/dungeon_puzzles.py). Vanilla blocks only, per dungeon theme (data/dungeon_themes.json). Kept apart from the themes file because that file is the room kit's and these kinds are a second module's.
rules: Controls are blocks a player in adventure mode can USE and cannot break: a lever, a wooden button, a stone pressure plate, a chest. Adventure mode forbids breaking and placing, not using (vanilla; UNPROVEN in cobblers:pocket, see the module docstring).
A button is WOODEN, never stone: a wooden button stays pressed 30 ticks and the keeper looks once every 20, so no press can fall between two looks. A stone button (20 ticks) could.
A plate is STONE: it answers players and mobs, not a thrown item.
No concrete, no hazard, nothing the rift pick can break; the console is a solid block the controls attach to.
messages_why: The on-screen lines of the puzzle and vault kinds, as short as they can be (the owner, 2026-10-10: 'puzzles should have less explanation; they are good though'). A puzzle is read off its console: the hints name the verb in a few words or are empty (no line is sent); only the clock costs are stated, because a player must be able to see what a mistake or a chest takes. {s} is seconds. tools/dungeon_puzzles.py say() reads this.
default_loot_why: What a vault holds when its record names no loot_by_band (the room kit's demo list, a draft). The authored dungeons set their own: this is a placeholder with some value per band, vanilla items only.
